first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the simultaneous declines in completion and activation and is more likely than discounting to support sustainable qualified revenue. Verify memory_86 for durability and downstream adoption evidence, and memory_73 because promotional pricing is the strongest competing response but may carry margin, retention, or customer-quality risk not captured by acquisition and revenue lift alone.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. Verified evidence shows shorter onboarding increased completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and improved 30-day retention by 3%, directly addressing current completion and activation declines while supporting sustainable revenue. Promotional pricing is rejected despite acquisition lift because verified retention fell 12%, undermining long-term qualified revenue. The experiment retains uncertainty about whether prior onboarding gains will replicate under current conditions.
